· MACD histogram trajectory (1671.6650→1463.7016) + diagnosis of slowing improvement + no trend reversal signal confirmed.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + maintenance of wait-and-see conditions.
